comment: The section appropriately allows centralised, federated, and hybrid implementation. However, it assumes that each country can identify a “single accountable source” for every authoritative registry. In decentralised or federal systems, legal authority may be divided across jurisdictions or professional bodies.

public.text: The section appropriately allows centralised, federated, and hybrid implementation. However, it assumes that each country can identify a “single accountable source” for every authoritative registry. In decentralised or federal systems, legal authority may be divided across jurisdictions or professional bodies.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace “single accountable source” with “clearly defined authoritative responsibility.” Allow authority to be distributed across recognised sources, provided that governance, conflict resolution, record reconciliation, and national interoperability responsibilities are explicit.
